mentions.name: CurateKit
mentions.description: A lightweight content curation tool for hosting collections of short texts, facts, and links on a standalone public-facing site. It includes a browser extension for clipping links with remarks that feed into a public list, and a "Substack-lite" feature for sending simple roundup email digests (e.g., "Top 5 links this week") to opt-in subscribers. The tool is in private beta, with waitlist invites opening.
mentions.problem: Growing lists of short texts, facts, and links end up buried in a notes app instead of being hosted on a standalone site.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building CurateKit.com - a lightweight content curation tool.

I always have growing lists of short texts, facts, and links that I wanted to host on a standalone site rather than burying them in a notes app. The workflow is simple: a browser extension to clip links with remarks, which then feeds into a public-facing list.

I’ve also added a "Substack-lite" feature. Instead of long-form writing, it lets you send simple roundup email digests (e.g., "Top 5 links this week") to opt-in subscribers.
